title: Our Kitchen
text:
This is our kitchen. It is big and bright. There is a fridge next to the window. A small table is in the middle.

My mother cooks here every day. She uses the cooker and the sink. We eat dinner at the table together. I like our kitchen.

questions.text: What is next to the window?
How does the writer feel about the kitchen?
Why do the family members eat dinner together?
options: They enjoy spending time as a family

vocabulary.definition: a room in a house where food is cooked
a cold box in a kitchen where food is kept fresh
an opening in a wall with glass that lets in light
a piece of furniture with a flat top and legs

paragraph_translations: Це наша кухня. Вона велика і світла. Поруч із вікном стоїть холодильник. Маленький стіл стоїть посередині.
Моя мама готує тут щодня. Вона користується плитою і раковиною. Ми обідаємо за столом разом. Мені подобається наша кухня.
